tasks.label: Activate and Run Demo
tasks.command: bash -c "source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m fase3.run_demo"

tasks.label: Install System Pip and Run Demo
tasks.command: bash -c "python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages -r requirements.txt && PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m fase3.run_demo"

tasks.label: Install Streamlit
tasks.command: bash -c "python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages streamlit && .venv/bin/pip install streamlit"

tasks.label: Remove non-Phase 3 files
tasks.command: bash -c "rm -rf ga_optimizer.py llm_interface.py monitoramento.py nlp_interpret.py run_experiments.py run_experiments_quick.py test_llm_call.py teste notebooks docs/arquitetura_scalabilidade.md docs/relatorio_tecnico.md docs/resultados_obtidos.md"

tasks.label: Rebuild Dataset and Run Demo
tasks.command: bash -c "PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m fase3.dataset_prep && PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m fase3.run_demo"
